headline: Bases Trade Hands Across Six Hot Sectors
war_summary: Since the 09:16 edition the most volatile fronts have deepened their churn. Weathered Expanse now records 37 ownership changes in the last 24 hours — up from 36 — with Colonial casualties climbing to 179,596 and Warden casualties to 197,640, both casualty rates and enlistments accelerating sharply. Stonecradle remains a flashpoint with 17 flips centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, pushing totals to 61,411 Colonial and 78,299 Warden dead. Mooring County has surged to 15 flips in the day, three in the past two hours, and a 24‑hour cost of 24,533 Colonial and 20,231 Warden. Fishermans Row, quiet in the prior report, now shows 14 flips across Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia and Eidolo, bringing its toll to 11,557 Colonial and 13,891 Warden. Farranac Coast holds steady at nine flips, losses at 48,461 Colonial and 60,053 Warden. Linn Mercy’s activity eases to six flips around Lathair, totals 54,722 Colonial and 69,101 Warden. Northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas show no ownership changes.
